text_block_list.text:
In order to encourage motivation and

self-improvement among the
Umamusume, the
academy is holding a
large-scale scrimmage.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As the day of the event rolls around,
Symboli
Rudolf, the head of the
organization committee,
looks on with
anticipation.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Spirits are positively stratospheric.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: See for yourself, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф gestures to the track,
where the
participating Umamusume are
eagerly getting
ready.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
C'mon, Spe! Scrimmage or not, I'll kick
your butt!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
That's what you think! You and everyone
else are
gonna eat my dust!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
You're lookin' pretty pale there, Scarlet.
Don't
tell me all the competition's got
you nervous?
text_block_list.name: Водка

text_block_list.text:
As if! I don't care how many racers I have
to beat,
I'll prove I'm number one!
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
Everyone is spirited today. They have
fire in their
eyes and dreams in their
hearts.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
That fire will lead them to a brighter
future. Such
is my constant hope.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
And today, my job as student council
president is
to stoke those flames.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
...Which is why I wish to ask you for
advice.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
How can I best encourage them to blaze
their own
trails?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Hah. I suppose the answer was obvious.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
We Umamusume are born to run. It is the
way by
which we show the world our true
selves.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Very well, then. I shall demonstrate to
them what
it looks like to have truly
mastered body and
mind.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф goes on to wow the
crowd and
competition alike with an
untouchable
performance in the first
race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: That... That was amazing!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
That was crazy... but it sure got me fired
up!
text_block_list.name: Водка

text_block_list.text:
I'd like to thank all of you once again for

gathering here today.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
As fellow Umamusume of the Twinkle
Series...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
May we continue to raise one another up
as we
strive to pursue our dreams!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф's inspiring performance
lights a
new fire in the hearts of her
fellow Umamusume.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
A sound idea. Ideals mean nothing if not
spoken
aloud—only once put into words
can others look
to them for guidance.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I shall give them a speech to remind
them of the
future we all strive toward.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
At the opening ceremony, after
delivering her
welcoming address and
going over a few
guidelines...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Last but not least, I would like to remind
you all
of one thing.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
We all race for the sake of something
that we
hold dear.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Something that we each hold deep
within
ourselves. Hope, perhaps, or
ambition, or even
yearning.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Everyone's reason is different, yet
equally noble.
And when we take to the
track with them in our
hearts...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Those who watch us are inspired to
dream.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф's words resound across
the track.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: We... inspire people to dream?
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text: Hehehe... Now I'm fired up!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I'd like to thank all of you for attending
today. I
hope to see you compete,
collaborate, challenge
one another...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
And forge a path together toward our
shining
future!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
She's worn the mantle of leader well
today,
offering an ideal for the others to
chase.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She's certainly succeeded in leading by
example.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
